{{Quote|Chewbacca...<br />File: Wookiee<br />Section: OC-356<br />Born: Sidereal Era AF 5076 on Kazhyyyk [sic]!|Mistress Mnemos|<ref name="The Constancia Affair">"[[The Constancia Affair]]"</ref>}}
'''"Wookiee"''' was the name of a file that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]-owned [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]] [[Mistress Mnemos]] utilized by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fusai/Legends|Fusai]]. Presumably, it contained details on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], who had acted as allies of the Rebel Alliance during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It possessed at least one section, OC-356, which gave details on [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], a Rebel Alliance member, although it lacked information on the specific relationship between Han Solo and Chewbacca, or the circumstances behind their meeting, which led to it asking C-3PO for these details, who denied knowing anything as he wasn't present at the time.
